learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn to correctly use Capital Letters, Full Stops, and Question Marks as traffic signals for reading and writing.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Imagine driving a car with no traffic lights! 🚗💥 It would be a mess. Reading without Punctuation is exactly like that. Let's learn the traffic signals of English grammar!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Punctuation marks are special signs in English that tell us when to stop, when to take a breath, or when we are asking something.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔠 The Big Boss: Capital Letter (बड़ा अक्षर)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use a Capital letter at the beginning of a sentence. We also use it for the word 'I', and for Special Names (Proper Nouns) like Rahul, Monday, or Delhi.
examples_or_templates: My friend Amit and I play on Sunday.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔴 The Red Light: Full Stop (पूर्ण विराम)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Full Stop (.) is a tiny dot that comes at the end of a telling sentence. It tells the reader, 'Stop here! The sentence is finished.'

lesson_modules.module_title: ❓ The Curious Mark: Question Mark (प्रश्नवाचक चिह्न)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we ask something, we don't use a Full Stop. We use a Question Mark (?). Words like What, Where, When, Who, and How usually bring a Question Mark at the end!

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which punctuation mark should end this sentence: 'How old are you'
❓ Which word MUST start with a Capital Letter?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add the correct punctuation at the end: 'Where are you going ____'
subjective_practice.hint: Is this a telling sentence or an asking sentence? (Put ? or .)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite correctly: 'i live in mumbai.'
subjective_practice.hint: The first letter should be capital, and special cities need a capital letter too!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add the correct punctuation at the end: 'My favorite color is green ____'
subjective_practice.hint: This sentence is just telling some information. (Put the red light dot!)

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 The Punctuation Police
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Become a police officer 👮! Ask your parents one 'telling' sentence (Full Stop) and one 'asking' sentence (Question Mark). Check if their voice changes when they ask a question!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Sentences start with a Capital Letter and special names also start with a Capital Letter.
⭐ The word 'I' is always written in Capital.
⭐ A telling sentence ends with a Full Stop (.).
⭐ An asking sentence ends with a Question Mark (?).
